title: Cartwise+ Membership Credit-Back Earning and Expiry Terms
content:
Cartwise+ Membership credit back is Cartwise+ credit earned on eligible completed orders and spendable on later orders. The earning terms per plan:

| Plan | Credit earned (% of eligible item subtotal) | Orders that earn | Minimum eligible item subtotal to earn (USD) | Maximum credit per order (USD) | Alcohol lines excluded from the eligible subtotal |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cartwise+ Assist Monthly | 2.0% | Curbside Pickup orders only | 10.00 | 5.00 | yes |
| Cartwise+ Student Monthly | 2.0% | Curbside Pickup orders only | 10.00 | 5.00 | yes |
| Cartwise+ Monthly | 2.0% | Curbside Pickup orders only | 10.00 | 5.00 | yes |
| Cartwise+ Annual | 5.0% | Curbside Pickup orders only | 10.00 | 10.00 | yes |
| Cartwise+ Family Annual | 5.0% | Curbside Pickup orders only | 10.00 | 10.00 | yes |
| Cartwise+ Premier Annual | 5.0% | pickup and delivery orders | 10.00 | 15.00 | yes |

The balance and expiry terms per plan:

| Plan | Balance cap (USD) | Each earning expires after (calendar days) | Minimum order item subtotal to apply credit (USD) | Remaining credit usable after cancellation (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Cartwise+ Assist Monthly | 50.00 | 90 | 10.00 | 30 |
| Cartwise+ Student Monthly | 50.00 | 90 | 10.00 | 30 |
| Cartwise+ Monthly | 50.00 | 90 | 10.00 | 30 |
| Cartwise+ Annual | 100.00 | 180 | 10.00 | 30 |
| Cartwise+ Family Annual | 100.00 | 180 | 10.00 | 30 |
| Cartwise+ Premier Annual | 200.00 | 365 | 10.00 | 30 |

## Column meanings

- **Balance cap**: credit earnings stop once the balance reaches this cap, and an earning is cut down to the room left under it.
- **Each earning expires after**: the number of calendar days after it was earned at which an earning's unspent remainder expires.
- **Remaining credit usable after cancellation**: how long the remaining credit stays usable after the membership is canceled, after which it expires.
